The only flagged issue by the Deepseek model was the source URL pointing to `tangled.org` instead of a hallucinated `atcr.io`. coverage_issues: Qwen model truncated its response during the full PKGBUILD review, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict.

learnings: Models may hallucinate 'official' upstream domains based on package names (e.g., assuming `atcr.io` for `atcr-git`) and flag legitimate alternative git hosts as supply-chain attacks.
